notes.title: Doors Open October 22
notes.content: [p]The wait is nearly over. This spooky season, the doors of Riddlewood Manor will creak open for everyone brave (or foolish) enough to enter. On October 22nd, the full game will be unleashed.[/p][p][/p][p]The manor has been patient, but its secrets are growing restless. You’ve seen glimpses through the demo and whispers from the beta—now the entire house is yours to explore.[/p][p][/p][p]What awaits you on release?[/p][p][/p][p]🪞 Twisting Corridors – every turn reveals a new puzzle, a hidden passage, or something watching from the dark.[/p][p]📜 Family Secrets – the tragic story of the Riddlewoods won’t stay buried.[/p][p]🧩 Eerie Puzzles – logic twisted just enough to make you laugh, scream, or both.[/p][p]🎙️ Voices in the Dark – a full cast brings every ghost, whisper, and unholy giggle to life. Creepy vibes included, free of charge.[/p][p]🗺️ The Manor Map – keep track of twisting halls and sprawling rooms… though some doors have a way of moving when you’re not looking.[/p][p]🪆 Suzie – she’s been waiting to play with you…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135039/1ec3b99b1ef4f2e60c880210e1616c48d423892c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]So mark your calendars, light a candle, and keep your wits about you. The manor will welcome you soon… whether you’re ready or not.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🕸️ Riddlewood Manor launches October 22nd. Wishlist now, and join us when the haunted halls finally open.[/b][/h2]

notes.title: Demo Is Now Live!
notes.content:
It’s time to slip through the doors of Riddlewood Manor for the very first time.

The [b]demo is now available[/b] and the manor is open to curious minds and brave souls. Inside, you’ll find creaky rooms full of peculiar puzzles, oddball residents with too many secrets, and the sort of cozy chaos you can only find in a place that’s slightly haunted and entirely charming. Whether you're here to solve a mystery or simply snoop around, you’re most welcome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135039/fa7c1b0ec24da23f1c4e430c0926205180a36c9f.jpg[/img]

[h2]What might you stumble across?[/h2]

🍳 A breakfast that raises more questions than it answers
🧪 A suspicious potion or two (don’t worry, probably harmless)
🐉 A very emotional dragon who just needs attention
🕯️ Rooms with very good memories… sometimes too good
🪆 Suzee! A demonic doll with excellent manners (most of the time)

Take your time. Peek behind the curtains. Rattle a few locked drawers. There’s plenty to discover!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135039/6bdf4a26fb85b445377174cffe081438f3653ef4.png[/img]

[i]P.S. - This demo is for the standard version of Riddlewood Manor. The VR version is still quietly stretching its legs behind the scenes. It’ll be ready when it’s ready.[/i]

notes.title: Closed Beta Out Now
notes.content:
This is your invitation to be among the first to explore the manor and uncover the truth behind the Riddlewood family. Strange puzzles, eerie whispers, and something watching from the shadows await.

The manor is not for all visitors. If you think you have the patience to unravel its mysteries and the nerve to face what lingers in the dark, we welcome you to join our Closed Beta.

[i]Do you have what it takes to survive?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135039/e6dc3aad459c67530a5d4997f745424a393d18d6.jpg[/img]
[h2]What You’ll Find Inside[/h2]

[h5]🔮 Unseen Forces[/h5]
Not every spirit is friendly. Some will help, some will hinder, and some will do far worse.

[h5]🧩 Puzzles With a Dark Past[/h5]
The Riddlewood family hid their secrets well. Every locked door, every cryptic note, and every out-of-place object has a purpose. The answers are there, if you know where to look.

[h5]🏚️ Rooms That Remember[/h5]
Each space tells a story. A child’s nursery, left exactly as it was the day she vanished. A study filled with papers no one should have read. A basement best left undisturbed.

[h5]👻 A Warning About the Dolls[/h5]
Some toys are not meant to be played with. Stay quiet. Stay alert.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135039/985fdef2179d4b8c8b65d0aee1e077425e7e5407.jpg[/img]
